1864906_7e74e56b.text: Our findings have revealed a sex dimorphic expression of Ngn3 in hypothalamic neurons. Male neurons, which show a retarded neuritic differentiation compared to female neurons, showed decreased mRNA levels of the neuritogenic factor Ngn3

1864906_84f3e647.text: female hypothalamic primary neurons differentiated earlier than male neurons in culture

1864906_58eed056.text: female neurons would show a higher number of postsynaptic sites available when early synaptic afferents arrive and could then, by this mechanism, establish a different pattern of synaptic connectivity than male neurons

1864906_5bd674b1.text: some parameters of the neuritogenic process are sexually dimorphic and others are sex-independent.
